JC.look: Dominican-American; narrow tired face, family almond eyes, short curly dark hair with faded sides, light stubble

JC.continuity: After chapter 23, deaf in right ear; right-palm coin burn; cut palm from chapter 15

MANNY.name: Manuel ‘Manny’
MANNY.build: 6 feet 3 inches, exceptionally broad shoulders and thick chest, enormous hands
MANNY.look: Afro-Dominican; broad open face, expressive eyebrows, easy grin; close-cropped hair with sharp lineup (adaptation choice)
MANNY.outfit: oversized tee or Knicks shirt, track pants, sneakers

MIKEY.name: Mikey
